raw_site_text: 91 villages across 8 districts of Bangladesh, namely Brahmanbaria, Chandpur, Comilla, Gazipur, Lakhipur, Munshiganj, Naranganj, and Noakhali
justification: Eight districts: Brahmanbaria, Chandpur, Comilla, Lakshmipur (Lakhipur), Noakhali in Chittagong division; Gazipur, Munshiganj, Narayanganj in Dhaka division.
note: Lakhipur read as Lakshmipur district (Chittagong division); Naranganj as Narayanganj (Dhaka division).
